### 1.6.4

* Telnet connection to VM's com port http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1851
* top or bottom toolbar http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/711#comment:3
* Switch off menu/statusbar http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/867
* Guest Additions context menu http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1836
* Visible indication as for which CD/DVD-ROM image is mounted http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1809
* change machine from VirtualBox main window while the machine is running http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1804
* GUI: Add several ISO CD images at once into Disk Manager http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1786
* Encrypted virtual disk http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1765
* Allow SMBIOS information to be copied from host http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1751
* Mac OS X Guest http://www.virtualbox.org/ticket/1071
